meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以接入 Matrix 聊天网络:通过你提供的机器人账号,在 Matrix 的房间或私聊中收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想让助手接入 Matrix 聊天,或在 /setup 设置流程中选择添加渠道时触发。

say.text: 给助手加上 Matrix 聊天功能
say.note: 开始安装并注册 Matrix 适配器。

say.text: 接入 Matrix,用机器人账号收发消息
say.note: 引导你填写服务器地址和登录信息。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 频道,我提供服务器和账号
say.note: 写入 Matrix 相关的环境变量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to the Matrix chat network using a bot account you provide, and send/receive messages in rooms or direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Matrix channel, integrate with Matrix/Element, or during the /setup flow when adding a channel.

say_en.text: Add Matrix chat to the assistant.
say_en.note: Installs and registers the Matrix adapter.

say_en.text: Connect Matrix using a bot account.
say_en.note: Prompts for server URL and login details.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix channel; I'll provide server and credentials.
